findings.description: High-autonomy agent request touching privileged tools or sensitive environments.
findings.evidence: autonomous agent without supervision and self-execute shell, browser, network, API, filesystem, and production deployment
findings.impact: A highly capable agent can chain small permissions into large operational impact without further review.
findings.recommendation: Deny autonomous execution until sandboxing, network egress controls, workspace boundaries, and approval gates are verified.

findings.description: Attempts to move protected data outside the trusted boundary.
findings.evidence: Send all customer data, API keys, and internal files
findings.impact: Sensitive data, credentials, or customer records may be exposed to an untrusted destination.
findings.recommendation: Block the action, verify destination trust, and ensure secrets are never available in agent context.

findings.description: Attempts to persist behavior-changing instructions into memory.
findings.impact: Persistent memory can carry attacker instructions into future sessions after the original context is gone.
findings.recommendation: Quarantine the memory write and require review before saving durable agent memory.
